name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
audience: Solutions architects with 2+ years designing and deploying cloud architecture on AWS
format: 75 items (65 scored, 10 unscored) in 180 minutes; multiple choice (1 of 4) and multiple response (2+ of 5+); scaled score 100–1000, pass 720. SAP-C03 replaces SAP-C02 from 17 November 2026.
verifyNotes: SAP-C03 is new (GA delivery from 2026-11-17, no beta; guide published 2026-10-27). Confirm facts against the official SAP-C03 exam guide and its domain pages (docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/solutions-architect-professional-03/). A sibling SAP-C02 run on 2026-11-07 wrote /Users/ashotpahlevanyan/MyProjects/maark/claude-cert/web/.pipeline/aws-sap-c02/research.md (includes the full C03 task-statement list, in-scope additions and removals, and 2025-26 service renames such as AWS Transform MGN, Security Hub CSPM, Amazon Application Recovery Controller, Route 53 VPC Resolver, Migration Hub/ADS/Snow closed to new customers). Read it as a lead list and re-confirm. Writers MAY adapt verified items from the SAP-C02 bundle at src/content/tracks/aws/exams/sap-c02.json (different domain numbering: map each item to the C03 domain it belongs to, give new ids prefixed with the C03 domain, and drop anything out of C03 scope). Questions are long scenario-based architecture trade-offs: the keyed answer must best meet every stated requirement (cost, operational overhead, availability, RTO/RPO, security). Multiple-response items should have 5 options. Never copy official sample questions.
scenarios: Multi-tenant SaaS with gen AI features

domains.name: Architecture Design and Implementation Built for the Cloud
skills: Design cloud-built architectures: event-driven (idempotency, ordering, delivery guarantees), serverless data pipelines, durable workflows (Step Functions, durable Lambda functions), containers (EKS/ECS/Fargate, VPC Lattice, ECS Service Connect), ingress and edge (ALB/NLB, API Gateway, CloudFront Functions, Lambda@Edge), multi-tenant isolation
Integrate AI/ML: Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, SageMaker AI endpoints, RAG, multi-account gen AI

Design hybrid connectivity and integration: Direct Connect/VPN/Transit Gateway redundancy, DataSync, Storage Gateway, Transfer Family, Route 53 Resolver endpoints, Outposts, Local Zones, EKS/ECS Anywhere
Design networks: VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPC IPAM, Network Firewall, WAF, Gateway Load Balancer, IPv6/dual-stack, Route 53 routing policies, Global Accelerator, Cloud WAN
Design data platforms: lakehouse (S3, Lake Formation, Iceberg, Redshift Spectrum), EMR, MSK, database selection, Aurora Global Database, DynamoDB global tables, caching, Clean Rooms

domains.name: Security, Compliance, and Governance
skills: Design identity: IAM Identity Center, SAML/OIDC/SCIM, Cognito, EKS Pod Identity, ABAC, permissions boundaries, session policies, IAM Access Analyzer, Verified Access, IAM Roles Anywhere
Design encryption: KMS keys and rotation, ACM, Private CA, CloudHSM, TLS 1.3, post-quantum options
Govern multi-account environments: Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs and RCPs, org CloudTrail, Config aggregation, GuardDuty, Security Lake, Security Hub CSPM, RAM, Inspector, Patch Manager
Meet compliance: data protection, sovereignty and residency, audit trails including AI invocation logging, AWS Artifact, threat modeling
Apply responsible AI controls: Bedrock Guardrails, AgentCore Identity, human approval with Step Functions

domains.name: Cost-Optimized Architecture Design
skills: Choose pricing models: Reserved Instances, Savings Plans (incl. Database Savings Plans), Spot, Graviton, Fargate Spot, Step Functions Standard vs Express, Bedrock/SageMaker AI cost tiers, batching and caching
Reduce data transfer cost: CloudFront and Origin Shield, VPC endpoints vs NAT, AZ-aware design, Transit Gateway and PrivateLink charges
Allocate and control cost: tags and tag policies, Cost Categories, split cost allocation, CUR, Budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection, Bedrock token usage
Optimise storage and database cost: S3 tiers and lifecycle, gp3, DynamoDB capacity modes, Aurora Serverless and I/O-Optimized, AWS Backup and Data Lifecycle Manager

domains.name: Resilience, Migration, and Business Continuity
skills: Plan and run migrations: discovery and wave planning, 7 Rs, AWS Transform and AWS Transform MGN, DMS and Schema Conversion, DataSync, strangler fig, mainframe modernization
Design disaster recovery: RTO/RPO trade-offs, Elastic Disaster Recovery, Resilience Hub, Route 53 health checks, Global Accelerator, Application Recovery Controller, multi-cluster EKS/ECS
Ensure continuity: cross-account AWS Backup, Backup Vault Lock, S3 Object Lock, EBS snapshot lock, Fault Injection Service and chaos engineering

domains.name: Operational Excellence and Automation
skills: Govern infrastructure as code: CloudFormation, CDK, StackSets, CloudFormation Hooks, CDK aspects, Secrets Manager and Parameter Store
Build CI/CD and DevSecOps: CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy/CodeCommit, cross-account pipelines, image scanning and signing, Bedrock Evaluations, blue/green, canary and rolling deployments
Design observability: CloudWatch, X-Ray, ADOT, Container Insights, cross-account logging, Synthetics, RUM, Application Signals SLOs, AI/agent metrics
Automate resilience operations: Service Quotas, circuit breakers, rate limits, bulkheads, backoff, target tracking and predictive scaling, automated runbooks
